races.rationale: Their stored seasonal light and view of habitat as inherited memory align with seasonal return, roots, and renewal.
Their existence between death and renewed life reflects rot transformed into rebirth rather than simple undeath.
Egg-clutches, metamorphic growth, and habitat-shaped life cycles reflect seasonal transformation and rebirth.
Fungi, roots, spores, decomposition, and ecological rebirth make Hathruna the central Jaspey deity.
Chosen molts and preserved seasonal skins enact visible cycles of shedding, return, and rebirth.
Rootlike limbs, seed nurseries, living growth, and seasonal garden renewal place them under the Root-Mother.
